feeds.title: Life in Italy
feeds.description: Life in Italy is a website about Italy and Italian Culture, Food, and Travel. We are also focusing on Italian news, sharing the most important updates from Italy with you!

feeds.title: Milano Style
feeds.description: Milanostyle.com is more than a blog about Milan, lifestyle and travel; it is a valuable resource for the reader offering an insider's view of visiting Milan, Lake Como, and other areas of il bel paese. MilanoStyle is not only about tourism and fashion but is an intimate look into an authentic experience of living in Italy.

feeds.title: Italophilia
feeds.description: The blog shares the wonderous diversity of the Italian culture along with travel tips, lifestyle, book recommendations and posts on language learning. Ishita Sood, author of the blog and an Indian in love with everything Italian. Italophilia aims to provide its readers with knowledge of Italy's rich culture and history along with its beautiful language.

feeds.title: Mama Loves Italy
feeds.description: On this site, you will find Italy's travel ideas, inspiration, guides, tips and lifestyle articles. Marta Correale, the travel-loving Italian Mama behind this Mama Loves Italy Blog, shares Italy travel ideas and tips that can help you plan a wonderful stay in the wonderful, complex, magical country.

feeds.title: Italia Living
feeds.description: A Fine Living & Luxury Portal to the Charm & Elegance of the Italian Lifestyle.

feeds.title: Dream of Italy Blog
feeds.description: The latest news from the experts in Italian Travel. Dream of Italy provides insider Italy travel advice to help you plan an authentic Italian vacation!

feeds.title: My Kind of Italy
feeds.description: Covers in-depth profiles of lesser known Italian winemakers, their stories and their wines. Mike and Elena live in Italy and write from extensive experience about Italian wine, olive oil, travel, food, culture and lots of other subjects.

feeds.title: Girl in Florence
feeds.description: I'm Georgette. This blog is primarily about my life in these two wonderful countries and travel tips coupled with some real talk, plus a generous helping of lifestyle and food tips for the city of Firenze, Zug and beyond.

feeds.title: Lifestyle Made in Italy
feeds.description: Lifestyle Made in Italy is a web magazine dedicated to lifestyle in all its facets: fashion, culture, travel, cuisine, and much more, rigorously made in Italy!

feeds.title: Italia Poza Szlakiem
feeds.description: Discover Italy off the beaten track with Magda, a polish travel blogger and author. Read interesting stories from Italian travels. Find guides to well-known and less-known places in Italy, accommodation recommendations, lots of practical advice, secrets of Italian cuisine, wine discoveries, and for dessert - aromatic espresso and dolce vita recipe!

feeds.title: Appunti Sul Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with all news and trends. Explore articles and notes on Appunti Sul blog by Cristina Giordano, a blogger who mainly deals with fashion, travel, technology, nutrition and well-being.

feeds.title: Hiking And Other Adventures In Italy
feeds.description: Explore Italy's hidden gems, secrets, wonders, and fascinating facts. Gain access to a world of captivating stories about Italy's rich culture, stunning landscapes, and historical landmarks. Hiking And Other Adventures is a subtsack publication highlighting hidden treasures, sharing insider tips, and immersing you in the enchanting tales that make Italy truly special.

feeds.title: She Go Wandering
feeds.description: ShegoWandering is an Italy travel and lifestyle blog, with a base in the region of Emilia-Romagna. A platform to discover the country through traveling and photography, while learning about traditions, habits, and lifestyle. Beside Italy, you can learn about Spanish, and other European destinations too!

feeds.title: Doing Italy Blog
feeds.description: I am Thea. Blogging about my life in Italy and offering curated off the beaten path tours to Italy.My goal with Doing Italy is to help you create the life of your dreams in Italy, on your terms, while avoiding many of the pitfalls that plague so many expats when they move abroad.

feeds.title: Italy Travel and Life
feeds.description: Italia! and ItalyTravelandLife.com are integrated magazines and websites dedicated to everything Italian. It covers every aspect of Italian life, from travel, holidays, and property to food, wine, and culture, we bring Italy closer to English-speaking readers worldwide.

feeds.title: Live in Italy Magazine
feeds.description: Build your authentic life in Italy! Live in Italy Magazine is an experiential lifestyle news site dedicated to anyone who has or will make Italy their home away from home. Read stories from expats and Italians.

feeds.title: The Italy Edit
feeds.description: The Italy Edit is a digital travel and lifestyle magazine dedicated to the best Italian culture, food, wine, art and design. The Italy Edit was founded in 2018 and rebranded in 2020.

feeds.title: Rossi Writes » Italy
feeds.description: The blog covers Italy's food, art, culture, lifestyle, history and more.Rossi Writes is a travel blog showing you Europe's most beautiful corners. With the emphasis on history and culture, the blog offers in-depth travel guides and tips for major cities and hidden gems.

feeds.title: Monica Cesarato Blog
feeds.description: A Blog on Venice & Italy. Information on what to do, where to go, what & where to eat in Venice.

feeds.title: Seeing and Savoring Italy
feeds.description: Seeing and Savoring Italy is an eclectic blend of current thoughts and information on Italian culture and living from Pamela Marasco, author, teacher and Italian food entrepreneur.

feeds.title: ArtTrav
feeds.description: Know more about art, travel, and life in Italy & Europe through Arttrav's blog. Also about life in Florence Italy, and things to do in Florence by an art historian. Arttrav is by art historian Alexandra Korey, her goal is to make art accessible. She writes about her travel experiences in Florence, Italy, Rome, Tuscany, and things that you can do there.

feeds.title: Calabria: The Other Italy Blog
feeds.description: Italy and often Calabria - Great Food, Quaint Towns, Museums & Culture, Language, Curiosities, Life and People - plus great Photos on My Italian Blog!

feeds.title: Susan Guillory Blog
feeds.description: When I got divorced in 2016, I had to reevaluate what I wanted out of life. I began traveling solo, and it felt incredible. More and more, I found myself drawn to Italy.

feeds.title: Italy by Natalia
feeds.description: My name is Natalia Rosiak, I'm 38 years old and I come from the Poznań area, where I still live. I happily spend my free time reading books and relaxing in nature with Nordic walking poles. In the fall, I also passionately pick mushrooms in the beautiful Polish forests. I'm a civil engineer by profession. feeds.title: Italy Magazine
feeds.description: Italy Magazine is produced by an international community of people who love Italy and Italian culture. We are dedicated to delivering content that celebrates beauty and authenticity in Italian travel, lifestyle, language, and food to help our readers stay connected to Italy in a meaningful way.

feeds.title: Aglio Olio E Peperoncino
feeds.description: My name is Eleonora Baldwin, I was born in the United States and raised in Rome, Italy. As a food and lifestyle writer, journalist and culinary/travel TV host based in Rome, I provide insider knowledge on the Italian lifestyle to an audience that exceeds 180,000 across 100+ countries. I launched the blog 'Aglio, Olio e Peperoncino' in 2009. In these I write about Italian culinary customs and way of life, review restaurants, provide useful tools for parents traveling with kids in Rome, and capture the Eternal City's essence in my amateur photography.

feeds.title: Romeing » Lifestyle
feeds.description: This insider guide on how to live like a local is the first free press, event and lifestyle magazine devoted to Rome and written entirely in English! Romeing is a magazine for tourists and expats visiting or living in Rome, including classifieds, an event calendar and feature articles written by locals with secret insight for your vacation or for those considering moving to live in Italy.

feeds.title: Italy Best
feeds.description: Italy Best is the newest online Italy magazine where you could find anything from the best travel tips from professional travel bloggers, as well as travel destination ideas, accommodations and reviews, Italian cuisine, and all the best Italian brands, no matter in what category you're searching for. We cover everything that's Italian, putting in the spotlight the Made in Italy label, helping you to know more about the country, and find everything you could be possibly searching for for your trip. On Italy Best, you'll find only the best of Italy!

feeds.title: Casa Chiesi Italian Blog
feeds.description: This is the Casa Chiesi Italian Blog on all things that relate to Italian Lifestyle! Here you will find our short blog post that complements our articles.

feeds.title: Francine's Place Blog » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Elisa, an Italian creative blogger, share lifestyle and creative tips, recipes, travel guides and many other ideas.

feeds.title: Girl in Milan Blog

feeds.title: Gustobeats

It has become a go-to source for information on Rome, dining, and broader travel and has recently been featured through major travel and media brands like Fodor's, USA Today Travel, 10Best, Tripology, EasyJet, Rough Guide to Italy and Peeta Planet (for Dubai One TV).

feeds.title: Art of Living On the Road Italy Blog
feeds.description: On the ALOR blog, I'm sharing my journey from debt to dreams including the changes I made to reduce my cost of living, put more money away, start working for myself, and find freedom of time. Get tips to reduce the cost of living, save money, and achieve financial freedom.
